title: Fairness and Bias in Multimodal AI: A Survey
findings: The survey finds that religious bias is a documented challenge in major datasets and Large Language Models. Several prominent models, including GPT-3, PaLM, Llama 2, Llama 3, Aurora-M, and BLOOM, are cited as exhibiting religious biases and stereotypes, which are learned from large-scale training data such as The Pile.

The specific measurement methods are not detailed, but the paper catalogues these findings from other literature.
